The [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]] '''Ranger-5 swoop''' was a single-occupant, unarmed vehicle.

[[Arden Telowe|Telowe]], the owner of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Desert Survey Office/Legends|Desert Survey Office]], used a modified [[swoop]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ranger-5 swoop appears in ''[[Secrets of Mos Eisley]]'' article in [[2001]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 7|''Star Wars Gamer'' 7]].
